_doc: Top-level per-server-looking state that registers no session reset (tests/unit/session-state-ownership.test.ts). This list only shrinks: the test fails an entry whose binding is gone or whose file now registers a reset. Keys are file + binding, never a line number. Categories: app-lifetime, host-keyed, dom-owned, pure-cache, transient, reset-elsewhere.

entries.reason: Lookups of the mounted message lists, each added on mount and removed by that list's own destroy; a session reset must not drop the registration of a list that stays mounted

Saves and shares in flight, each removed in its own finally, so a second tap does not save twice

Intl date formatters keyed by locale, clock, time-zone offset and options; holds no server data
Projection of threads.store, which publishes the empty view from its own registered reset; it holds nothing until that store has loaded
